theorem lg_target {G : Type v} [Group G] [Finite G] : CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat.incl := by
  intro F
  apply CategoryTheory.Limits.comp_preserves_colimits_of_shape
    (CategoryTheory.Functor.id (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G))
    (FintypeCat.incl)
    (by apply_instance)
